_note: DE thin-coverage round 4. Works the 37 genuinely-open Chapter 10.1 rows that de-destatis-source-surveys.json's own _dropped note lists (round 10 made that note accurate: four rows resolved, two REFUSED, so 37 open and not 43). Method is round 3's: the German GNI inventory (esa-2010-methods.pdf, 372pp, 4.4MB) fetched live in the cloud sandbox and read for BODY-TEXT sentences that name a source statistic by title AND by EVAS number AND say what the accounts do with it. Chapter 10's table row alone was never treated as sufficient -- see the first open question for why that is a ruling and not a research gap. 21 rows had such a sentence; 16 did not and stay open, each with its reason. Node titles are the publisher's own words for the artefact taken from this same document (PLAYBOOK-CORPUS §7c), with the Chapter 10 register gloss recorded as a title_alias where the two differ -- the same multi-gloss handling round 3 used for EVAS 71211. One title_alias was deliberately NOT recorded (EVAS 71712's register gloss, see that node). Node urls are the publisher's canonical per-statistic GENESIS-Online pages, all verified 200 this round; they are Angular shells, so they are a node url and never evidence.
_headline: DE: +21 nodes, +21 edges, all off one document already cited in this corpus. Chapter 10.1's open rows go from 37 to 16.
_open_questions: THE RULING THIS ROUND KEPT HITTING, and it is Thomas's, not a research pass: 8 of the 16 rows left open appear in Chapter 10's table and NOWHERE in the 372-page body -- 12111 Population census, 21372 (higher-education finance, quarterly), 31141 Statistics of demolition of buildings and dwellings, 44241 (annual survey, finishing trade and property developers), 71512 and 71517 (quarterly cash results), 71811 Annual accounts of extra budgets, 79931 Energy tax statistics. PLAYBOOK-CORPUS §7a admits a methodology table cell that names a source as caption-equivalent and grades it A, and Chapter 10 is exactly such a table -- its title is 'Main data sources used'. What it discloses per row is an X against the Production/Expenditure/Income column, i.e. WHICH APPROACH the source feeds, not what the accounts compute from it. Every mint in rounds 2, 3 and 4 rested on a body sentence instead. Reading the table row as sufficient would move all eight at once, on one decision; refusing it leaves them permanently unwirable from this document. Neither is a research question.

The other 8 open rows are refused on evidence, not left unread. Five are cited ONLY inside an EVAS BUNDLE the document never separates: 43211 appears only as 'EVAS 43211 and 43221', 23121 only as 'the annual hospital statistics (EVAS 23111, 23112, 23121)', 51141 and 51231 only as 'the monthly ITGS (EVAS 51141, 51231)' / 'the external trade statistics (EVAS 51141, 51231)', 44221 only as 'the annual business and investment survey (EVAS 44211, 44221)'. Wiring one member of a bundle asserts a division of labour the sentence does not make. Three more are named only in a phrasing too generic to carry a node title: 42252 is cited twice as 'the annual structural survey (SE)', 71711 as 'the budgets of the Federal Government, the federal states and the municipalities' with no artefact title at all, and 31121 only as 'the construction activity statistics', which is the family name covering EVAS 31111 as well. The ITGS pair is the most valuable of the eight -- 'monthly ITGS' would be a real node if minted as ONE international-trade-in-goods node rather than split across two EVAS rows, and this corpus already carries ITGS nodes elsewhere; that is a scoping question, not an evidence one.

Chapter 10.2 (16 other official sources) is untouched by this round and its own note in de-destatis-source-surveys.json is the accurate worklist: KBA motor vehicle statistics, BaFin insurance and pension statistics, banking statistics, EMU interest rate statistics, Economic Accounts for Agriculture and the Bundesnetzagentur telecommunications annual report are still open; the Bundesbank Monthly Report and Annual Report are refused, twice, and must not be opened a third time. Chapter 10.3 (7 non-government sources) is still lowest priority and untouched.

The 47415 -> 47410 and 45341/45342 -> 47410 successions are real and are NOT minted here. Both are `supersedes`, which is a Relation and not a dependency edge, and no round has opened that shape for this branch. All five nodes carry the succession in their descriptions so the lead survives.
